profile.name: pyUVVIS紫外-可见光谱采集软件
profile.description: 一个非物理的桌面图形软件组件，用于实验中的紫外-可见光谱采集与显示。它可连接 UC480 相机或 Ocean Optics 光谱输入设备，执行实时读数、波长轴处理、曝光与增益调节、暗背景扣除、平均记录、曲线绘图，以及数据保存和加载。
profile.description_en: A non-physical desktop GUI software component for UV-Vis spectral acquisition and display in laboratory experiments. It can connect to UC480 cameras or Ocean Optics spectral input devices, perform real-time readout, wavelength-axis handling, exposure and gain adjustment, dark subtraction, averaging/recording, curve plotting, and data save/load operations.

registry.name: Py Uvvis
registry.description: PY Uvvis是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、加载、启动、数据保存、绘图、记录。支持OnQuit, OnRTBAvgDec, OnRTBAvgInc等操作。
